description:
Create an elliptical pixel selection from a bounding box (anti-aliased).

Use when: circular or oval masks, vignettes, or radial edits inside a region.
Do NOT use when: a rectangular region is enough — use photoshop_select_rectangle.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { shape, bounds?, context } }.
Preconditions: active document; right > left and bottom > top. Side effects: replaces current selection.

bottom.description: Bottom edge of bounding box in pixels

document_id.description: Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. Send null or 0 to use the active document. A positive number activates that document before the tool runs. When no document is open, a stale id does not block the call.

left.description: Left edge of bounding box in pixels

right.description: Right edge of bounding box in pixels

top.description: Top edge of bounding box in pixels

name: photoshop_select_ellipse
